verdict.rationale: Riveter is an API-first scraping and enrichment SaaS, so a prebuilt n8n or Zapier connector is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence documents only webhooks, typed SDKs, and an MCP connector for AI assistants. None of these is a prebuilt no-code automation-platform integration, and nothing mentions n8n, Zapier, Make or similar.
